depth_findings.text: archive_threads (grpc.rs, bulk archive for a user, around line 7048) builds its THREAD_ARCHIVED idempotency key as format!("{thread_id}:archived"). After a restore that thread can be archived again through this path too, so the INSERT hits idx_events_idempotency_key and the whole bulk transaction rolls back. Same root cause as the fixed archive_thread bug; fix it the same way (key per archive instance, for example the archived_at value per row) in a follow-up or with the lead's approval.

results.notes: Required fix 1 applied in apps/Model Plane/rust/services/session-core/src/grpc.rs. archive_thread now builds its THREAD_ARCHIVED idempotency key as format!("{}:archived:{}", req.thread_id, archived_at.to_rfc3339()), where archived_at is the value the UPDATE stored for this archive instance (the UPDATE only runs when archived_at IS NULL, so a restored thread gets a new value on each archive). It has the same collision after a restore, so an archive-all after a restore of one of its threads would fail with Status::internal. The reviewer named only archive_thread, so I did not widen the change; see depth_findings P1.
